children: Magnum Ice Cream delivered a strong third quarter, bolstered by an extended summer, with organic sales growth of 9.6%, Barclays's Warren Ackerman says in a note. The ice-cream company had market share gains across all regions, which indicates that execution is improving. The company's beat was across the board, he says. Furthermore, the increase in Magnum's organic sales growth guidance to 5.5% for the year, from 3% to 5% previously, is important too, he adds. Shares rise 3.3% in early morning trade.(aimee.look@wsj.com)
